ArtFreq

VST3 macOS

ArtFreq lets you draw in sound. Type, paint, or drop in a picture and it plays back in time with your track, showing up in the spectrogram.

Draw it your way

Type a word, drop in a logo, paint a sweep. If it shows on the canvas, it plays.

In time with the song

One beat or thirty-two bars. ArtFreq loops your drawing with the track, from the transport or a MIDI note.

See it in the spectrogram

Open MiniMeters or any spectrogram and your drawing is right there in the audio.

Details

  • 20 Hz to 20 kHz canvas
  • 1 beat to 32 bars
  • Layers for stacking drawings
  • Low, Mid, High and Full bands
  • Density, Contrast, Level
  • Transport or MIDI triggering
  • Bounce to WAV
  • 85 ms latency, reported to your DAW

ArtFreq FX comes with the Pro bundle.

Questions

Which DAWs does it work in?

Any DAW that hosts VST3 plug-ins.

Mac only?

Yes, for now. VST3 on macOS.

Do I need MiniMeters?

No. Any spectrogram shows it. MiniMeters is just the one in the screenshots.

How do I get it after I buy?

Download link right after checkout. License lands in your email.
